name: NJM2082 / NJM2082D / NJM2082DD / NJM2082M / NJM2082V
tagline: New JRC's faster (20 V/µs) take on the NJM082; Japanese DIYers call it a fuller, calmer TL072/NJM072 swap.

lineage.note: Improved NJM082, NJR's TL082-type second source. Datasheet Ver.2003-03-17.
Formed by the NJR–Ricoh Electronic Devices merger. Distributors list NJM2082D/M under Nisshinbo.

part_numbers.note: Base part. English datasheet NJM2082_E, Ver.2003-03-17.
DIP8 (0.300 in). Listed at DigiKey under Nisshinbo. Also seen as 'NJM#2082D'.
Noise-screened DIP grade (ノイズ選定品) sold by Kyohritsu/eleshop; not in 2003 datasheet.
DMP8 (SOP8) surface mount. Listed at DigiKey under Nisshinbo.
SSOP8 variant; seen only on a datasheet mirror listing (datasheetq).

reputation.summary: Praise comes from a few Japanese hobbyist sources. The C-Area wiki found the NJM2082D heavier and more composed than the TL072CP, with better extension at both ends. A zigsow review calls the DD grade an 'improved 072': slightly warm like the NJM072 but more neutral. The dad8893 blog includes it in a JFET listening comparison.
typical_uses: Drop-in for TL072/NJM072 in DIY headphone amps, preamps
caveats: Impressions are subjective and come from a few Japanese sources.
The DD 'noise-screened' grade is a retailer claim with no vendor specification behind it.
As a JFET dual it has more voltage noise than bipolar duals like NJM4580 or NE5532.

counterfeit_notes: No NJM2082-specific counterfeit or remarking reports are known. Take care with marketplace 'DD' parts: the noise screening is a sales grade, and only the suffix marking shows it.

claims_confirmed: Mouser datasheet is titled 'DUAL J-FET INPUT OPERATIONAL AMPLIFIER', stamped Ver.2003-03-17 (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/njr_njm2082_e-547184.pdf).
Second Mouser path NJM2082_E-218423.pdf carries the same Ver.2003-03-17 (https://www.mouser.com/ds/2/294/NJM2082_E-218423.pdf).
Described as an improved NJM082 for fast integrators, DACs, sample-and-hold and audio (https://www.mouser.com/ds/2/294/NJM2082_E-218423.pdf).
Supply ±4 V to ±18 V, input resistance 10^12 Ω typ, slew 20 V/µs typ (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/njr_njm2082_e-547184.pdf).

DigiKey lists NJM2082M (8-DMP) and NJM2082D under Nisshinbo (https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/nisshinbo-micro-devices-inc/NJM2082M/805549, https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/njr-corporation-njrc/NJM2082D/673709).
The alldatasheet copy is 5 pages, 226 KB (https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/7246/NJRC/NJM2082.html).
GBW 5 MHz and noise 13 nV/√Hz are reported but not read off the datasheet table; kept as unconfirmed (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/njr_njm2082_e-547184.pdf).
